title: lemon-herb aussie chicken wings skewers
description: tangy, crunchy and show-stopping australian-inspired chicken wings skewers using lemon, herbs, and australian bush spices. served with a side of tangy honey mustard sauce

ingredients.name: olive oil (60ml)
ingredients.notes: infused with lemon zest and rosemary

instructions: preheat your oven to 200 degrees celsius. line a baking tray with foil and set aside.
cut the chicken wings into 12 equal pieces and thread them onto metal skewers.
in a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, rosemary leaves, lemongrass paste, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, salt and pepper.
add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
let it marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
remove the chicken from the marinade and thread them onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
place the skewers onto the prepared baking tray and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.
meanwhile, prepare the tangy honey mustard sauce by whisking together 120ml of honey, 120ml of mustard and 60ml of lemon juice.
remove the chicken from the oven and brush with the tangy honey mustard sauce.
serve immediately, garnished with fresh rosemary leaves and lemon wedges.
serve with a side of tangy honey mustard sauce for dipping.
discard any leftover sauce and store the chicken in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
label the leftovers with the date and contents.
